<subject>Stonegate Associates?</subject>
<body>
Antony,

Stonegate Associates, on behalf of the Law Society, will be soliciting proposals for external counsel services. We are currently contemplating limited engagement retainers, and would like to get a Master Services Agreement in place. We would like to do a quick follow up in regards to the status of the MSA between yourselves and the Law Society. If your compliance department has any questions or concerns, please contact Dale Fletcher of Stonegate Associates at +44 7817 646361.

To address any insurance and indemnity concerns you may have, the Society is currently preparing a complete risk management framework which we will forward to you upon its completion.

Again, please do not hesitate to call.

Thank You,
Judith Dennis
Contract Administration
Stonegate Associates
+44 7817 646361
</body>
